mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the average return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% within a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the risk of a near-term recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.2pp in one month, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals a contraction in the real economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 103.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 103.0 for two months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 3.5%, the market prices in a high-cost environment for capital, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 470,000 million dollars, combined with a concurrent rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized, indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS > 470000 and GDPC1 > 2.0% fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a predictive model has a non-positive coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 200,000, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 103.5 for three consecutive months, combined with a concurrent rise in the federal funds rate above 0.75%, indicates a supply-side contraction under monetary tightening, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 103.5 for 3 consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS > 0.75%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances when both INDPRO < 103.5 for 3 months and FEDFUNDS > 0.75%, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
